Freelancer with ADHD: old me worked till midnight. Me now? Off at 5pm 🌅

9am: I didn't wait to feel ready. I told FOCO the first task, and it broke the client feedback into four tiny steps. Done by 9:30. Then the invoices, same way: one step, one timer, jazz on. 3pm: no panic, I'm actually ahead. 5pm: laptop closed. 6pm: a walk and a coffee. No guilt.

What would you do with your evenings back? 👇
Save this for the next time you're working at midnight 📌
